html:
Question 12

Sophia and Charlie decide to go to the sea to study some marine species. While Charlie dives 14.2 meters below sea level, Sophia waits for him in the boat, 2.5 meters above sea level. How many meters above Charlie is Sophia?

a
 13.3m
b
 11.7m
c
 16.7m
d
 14.5m
e
 17.3m
